title: Pure Battlin' Boxer
summary: Battlin' Boxer and Battlin' Boxing cards paired with the archetype's Number / Chaos Number Xyz monsters, Flamvell Counter, and Reinforcement of the Army. The deck swarms Level 4 FIRE Warriors into Rank 4 and Rank 5 Xyz bosses backed by searchable Counter Traps.

summary.title: Starters
points: Battlin' Boxer Promoter Special Summons itself when the opponent controls a monster, Tributes itself to summon up to 2 Battlin' Boxers with different names from the Deck, and banishes itself from the GY to adjust Boxer Levels.

Battlin' Boxer Uppercutter searches any Battlin' Boxer monster or Counter Counter Trap on Normal or Special Summon, and either revives a Boxer or sets a Counter Counter Trap when sent to the GY by a card effect.
Battlin' Boxer Switchitter revives a Battlin' Boxer from the GY on Normal Summon, while Reinforcement of the Army searches Promoter, Uppercutter, or Switchitter.

summary.title: Opening: Battlin' Boxer Promoter or Uppercutter
steps: Normal Summon Battlin' Boxer Uppercutter to search Battlin' Boxer Sparrer or Battlin' Boxing Cross Counter, or Tribute Battlin' Boxer Promoter to summon Uppercutter and Battlin' Boxer Glassjaw from the Deck.
Overlay two Level 4 Boxers into Battlin' Boxer King Dempsey, which searches or sends to the GY any Level 4 or lower FIRE Warrior or Battlin' Boxing Spell/Trap such as Battlin' Boxing Spirits.

Detach Uppercutter or Glassjaw by card effect (via King Dempsey's Quick Effect or Battlin' Boxer Shadow) to trigger their GY effects, reviving another Boxer or recovering a card from the GY to make Battlin' Boxer Lead Yoke or Number 79: Battlin' Boxer Nova Kaiser.

summary.title: Effect Detach & Floating Engine
summary.text: Both Battlin' Boxer Glassjaw and Battlin' Boxer Uppercutter trigger when sent to the GY by a card effect rather than as a cost. Because Battlin' Boxer King Dempsey, Battlin' Boxer Lead Yoke, and Battlin' Boxer Shadow detach Xyz Materials as part of their effect resolution, detaching Glassjaw adds a Battlin' Boxer back from the GY to the hand, and detaching Uppercutter revives a Battlin' Boxer from the GY or sets a Counter Trap.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Battlin' Boxer King Dempsey searches or dumps a FIRE Warrior or Battlin' Boxing card on summon, protects your Warriors from targeting, and detaches a material as a Quick Effect.
Battlin' Boxer Lead Yoke detaches a material whenever a Battlin' Boxer you control would be destroyed by battle or card effect and gains 800 ATK each time.

Number 79: Battlin' Boxer Nova Kaiser attaches Boxers from the hand or GY and floats into Level 4 Boxers when destroyed, while Rank-Up-Magic Barian's Force upgrades it into Number C79: Battlin' Boxer General Kaiser to negate Special Summons.
Number 105: Battlin' Boxer Star Cestus and Number C105: Battlin' Boxer Comet Cestus force battle damage onto the opponent and burn for destroyed monsters' ATK.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Battlin' Boxing Spirits mills the top card of your Deck (capable of triggering Glassjaw or Uppercutter) to revive a Battlin' Boxer in Defense Position.

Battlin' Boxing Cross Counter negates an opponent's monster effect, destroys your Battlin' Boxer or Number Xyz to summon a different Battlin' Boxer Xyz from the Extra Deck, and attaches Cross Counter to it as material.

Jolt Counter negates any Spell, Trap, or monster effect during the Battle Phase, and Flamvell Counter banishes a 200-DEF FIRE monster (Uppercutter or Glassjaw) from the GY to negate any Spell or Trap.

allow.Number 105: Battlin' Boxer Star Cestus: Archetypal Over-Hundred Number that forces an opponent's monster to take battle damage and negates its effects.
allow.Number C105: Battlin' Boxer Comet Cestus: Archetypal Chaos Number that burns on battle destruction and detaches a material to destroy a monster and burn for its ATK.
allow.Number 79: Battlin' Boxer Nova Kaiser: Archetypal Rank 4 Xyz that attaches Battlin' Boxers from hand/GY and floats into Level 4 Boxers upon destruction.
allow.Number C79: Battlin' Boxer General Kaise: Archetypal Rank 5 Chaos Xyz that negates Special Summons and detaches a Boxer to attach an opposing monster in battle.
allow.Rank-Up-Magic Barian's Force: Ranks up Nova Kaiser or Star Cestus into General Kaiser or Comet Cestus.
allow.Flamvell Counter: Counter Trap searchable by Battlin' Boxer Uppercutter (as Glassjaw has 200 DEF) that negates any Spell or Trap.
allow.Reinforcement of the Army: Searches Battlin' Boxer Promoter or Uppercutter.
